title: Queue items store state instead of dated events
what: An item's state is kept three times (the state field, the done/ folder, the filled fields) and nothing checks they agree; closed_by always equals taken_by (done refuses another branch); no field says when an item was taken, closed or dropped, and release erases who took it. Replace state and closed_by with taken_at/taken_by, closed_at (+ test), dropped_at (+ dropped_why), UTC timestamps; state is computed (dropped_at -> dropped, closed_at -> done, taken_at -> taken, else open). Rules: found <= taken_at <= closed_at; closed_at needs a test; dropped_at needs dropped_why and no closed_at; a file is in done/ exactly when closed_at or dropped_at is set. A one-time script fills the dates of the existing items from git history.
why: The owner, 24 Oct: "Я мыслю категорией - если мы можем предотватить сценарий где оно ломается, то лучше это сделать"; "При проектировании баз данных я сам категорически против полей status, они ничего не дают и их легко посчитать исходя из "реального" состояния объекта"; "Вместо updated_at я помечаю событийно - closed_at, taken_at, dropped_at, у полей так же есть правила валидации"; "Мы конечно всё ещё сможем найти дату изменения по git - но это неудобно делать с помощью аналитических скриптов". Picks: "а а" (event fields with the done/ folder kept and checked; ip 95).
failing_case: A file with "state": "open" and "taken_by": "wt/x" passes check() today (lib/relay_queue.py:60-96 checks only that state is one of four words), so `relay queue` lists it as open while a branch holds it; and "how long did runner-turns-while-waiting wait between found and taken" cannot be answered from its file (no taken_at), only by parsing git log.
pass_cases: check() refuses an item whose fields contradict (closed_at without a test, closed_at before taken_at, dropped_at with closed_at, a done/ file without closed_at or dropped_at); take, release, done and drop write the matching *_at field; every existing item after migration carries the dates git gives; queue views compute state from the fields; no file holds a state key.
